patterns: Definitions dominate: mixed farming = crops + livestock (APPSC and UPSC), viticulture = grapes, vertical farming = year-round crops in non-tropical regions, jhum in NE India.
Largest-producer one-liners are the commonest shape (rubber Thailand, cocoa Côte d'Ivoire/Ghana, coffee Brazil, saffron Iran, castor India, rice exporter India); several old keys are outdated.
APPSC Group-1 asked the geographer behind 4 macro regions of India (Sengupta & Sdasyuk); Borlaug's nationality and HYV origin in Mexico recur.
App uses many A-R and 'how many' items and long region lists; exam keeps to one fact per question.
